description: This file defines the 'module' package, including the 'Version' struct, error types related to modules and versions, and functions for validating, escaping, unescaping, and matching module paths and versions within the Go module system.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a module version with a path and version string.

classes.name: ModuleError
classes.description: Indicates an error related to a specific module path and version.

classes.name: InvalidVersionError
classes.description: Indicates an invalid version string, possibly pseudo-version.

classes.name: InvalidPathError
classes.description: Indicates a malformed module, import, or file path.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Version, e.g., 'path@version' or just 'path' if version is empty.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns an error message for ModuleError or InvalidVersionError.

methods.name: Unwrap
methods.description: Returns the underlying error for ModuleError or InvalidVersionError.

methods.name: noun
methods.description: Returns 'version' or 'pseudo-version' depending on whether the version is a pseudo-version.
